neighbours.label: Divine attributes in Qur'anic or devotional register (God is the Wise, All-Knowing, well acquainted with all things, Forgiving), vs the same adjectives describing people
fire: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy.
Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
He is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and He is aware of all things.
Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise in His judgment.
Verily, your Lord is Most Knowing of who strays from His way.
quiet: My aunt is a careful listener and sees everything.
Our coach is forgiving and full of patience.
The old doctor was knowing and wise.
She is the one who designed the garden, and she is aware of every plant.
The general was strong in battle and wise in his judgment.
My brother knows best which road leads to the lake.
The village is self-sufficient and proud of its farms.
